description: Several writes on ONE site at non-overlapping positions inside one intervened model - the multi-position patch. It is legal today and appeared in no example, which is why every run that wanted it re-derived it. Not a nicety: in the A3B question-mark study positions -4/-3/-2 each read 0.000 at all 40 layers when patched alone, and 0.367 -> 1.000 when patched jointly, so a single-position scan cannot see the effect at all. Rule 8 is what makes this expressible: at most one absolute write per (site, OVERLAPPING pos, model), so three disjoint indices are three legal absolute writes rather than a conflict. Read the counterfactual once per position; the reads share the forward.
